knobs.note: BH-3548: how far back the daily run looks for merged PRs to score. Read by bin/lead-review-precision.sh as ${LEAD_REVIEW_PRECISION_WINDOW_DAYS:-30}.

BH-3548: a fraction, not a percent. A repo whose lead MERGE precision (merged lead MERGEs never reverted and never failed in a Queue: batch, over all scored lead MERGEs) is under this, with at least LEAD_REVIEW_PRECISION_MIN_N scored, gets one warn beat a day. Read as ${LEAD_REVIEW_PRECISION_WARN:-0.9}.
BH-3548: the fewest scored lead MERGEs a repo needs before a low precision warns. Below it the day file still records the number. Read as ${LEAD_REVIEW_PRECISION_MIN_N:-5}.

BH-3548: the most 100-row pages read from the closed-PR list and from main's commits per repo per run. Hitting it inside the window sets truncated:true in the day file. Read as ${LEAD_REVIEW_PRECISION_MAX_PAGES:-30}.

BH-3683: a fraction, not a percent. A governed repo (live lead_protected_paths rows) whose lead MERGE precision is under this, with at least LEAD_REVIEW_PRECISION_MIN_N scored, has its lead_authority row set to human:precision (every lead MERGE is advice until a --source human verdict) and pages once; at or above it, a human:precision row goes back to lane. Below the warn line on purpose: the warn digest leads, the page follows. Read as ${LEAD_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_MIN_PRECISION:-0.8}.
